latePromenade.text: Everyone uptown walks the Royal Gardens before luncheon, slowly, in their best, nodding to the people they've decided to nod to. Nobody looks at the flowers. Everybody looks at everybody.

firstCupboardVisit: Back in the cupboard under the stairs, Mir shows you this break's project: a clock that runs backwards when it's sad. You crack your head on the lintel again. "Character," Mir says sympathetically.
firstPaintingAttempt: You do the banisters this time, slightly better. She adds a cat on the landing that isn't there. "There will be," she says.

forcedAuctionWithEmptyPurse.say: You scratch your nose. You now own a crate of mackerel, a crate of herring, and very nearly a boat. You sell them on for less than you paid, smelling of fish, and the buyers clap you on the back.
